transform_text_to_speech_request: transform a text-to-speech request to a provider-specific format with model, input, voice, and optional params
transform_text_to_speech_response: transform a provider response into standard HttpxBinaryResponseContent format for downstream consumption
map_openai_params: map OpenAI TTS parameters to provider-specific parameters for a given model and optional voice config
validate_environment: validate the environment for a text-to-speech provider by checking headers, model, api_key, and api_base
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of OpenAI TTS parameters supported by a specific text-to-speech provider model
